evidence.why: Shows independent background/text guards and the increment, reset-above-16, and draw-above-eight branches.

facts.rationale: Corrects the previous rationale's 16-step characterization while preserving its supported flag guards and visibility thresholds.
facts.value: DEVTEXT_FLAG_HIDEBACKGROUND suppresses both backing rectangles. DEVTEXT_FLAG_HIDETEXT suppresses the character grid and all cursor processing. With text visible and DEVTEXT_FLAG_SHOWCURSOR set, the counter increments once per draw, resets to zero after exceeding 16, and draws the cursor only at post-increment values 9 through 16. The established cycle therefore contains 17 updates, including the reset-to-zero update, with eight visible states.

evidence.why: Shows independent creation paths, nested camera failure handling, pool reset, callback guard, and unconditional result assignment.
Shows where the reset devtext_cobj pointer is subsequently allocated and configured.

facts.rationale: Separates the descriptor-backed camera construction from later lazy orthographic initialization and accurately describes assignment of the nullable drawing-host result rather than saying it remains NULL.
facts.value: Setup records scheduling inputs and resets devtext_cobj to NULL, but does not populate that lazy orthographic-camera pointer. It separately attempts descriptor-backed camera-GObj creation, resets the pool and active list, and attempts drawing-GObj creation. Successful drawing-GObj creation installs DevText_DrawAll; either way its result is assigned to devtext_gobj and returned, including NULL on failure. Camera-GObj failure does not prevent the remaining setup steps. No cleanup of previous camera or drawing-GObj instances is shown here.
